held_tool_pins.reason: Held deliberately: the flake8-bandit (S) rules were enabled on this pin, and a version bump changes the default rule set in ways that are not separable from a select change afterwards. Confirm the new default rules before any bump.

Held deliberately: the CI lint job type-checks services/ai_control_plane/src on this pin, and a mypy upgrade can add or reclassify errors. Rerun the check locally on the candidate version before any bump.

Held deliberately: the control-plane CI job regenerates services/ai_control_plane/requirements.lock from uv.lock with this uv and fails on any diff, and a uv upgrade can change the export header or formatting. Rerun the export on the candidate version and commit the regenerated file in the same PR as the bump.

manual_review_notes.name: playwright_npm_versus_image_coherence
manual_review_notes.note: scripts/check-dependency-updates.py fails unless the @playwright/test pin in tests/e2e/package.json and its tests/e2e/package-lock.json entry equal playwright_image.version, and the PLAYWRIGHT_IMAGE digest in development/.env.example equals playwright_image.digest, so a Dependabot npm bump stays red until the image and this record move with it. The gate cannot tell which version a digest is: when moving PLAYWRIGHT_IMAGE, confirm by hand that the new digest is the one the registry publishes for the new version, update both playwright_image fields in the same PR, then run scripts/dev.sh e2e-test.
